beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful AI product can succeed with customers and still lose its independence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Investing in an AI-Dominated Economy builds its thesis around that uncomfortable distinction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks where bargaining power moves as capable software becomes easier to produce.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It presents the strategic doctrine behind Outfinity Venture Studio, including its unresolved wager.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader is offered an investment framework to examine, not a promise of returns.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central interest is what an organization accumulates beyond access to a model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Research, rights, workflow, and accountable institutions become candidates for more durable value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Understanding why they might matter is the reason to enter the argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The historical chapters interpret computing transitions as changes in strategic control points.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A new platform can preserve an old function while changing who captures its value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Documents still need writing even when collaboration changes the surrounding business model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats AI as another recomposition of this kind.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Models provide reusable capability while systems organize context, permissions, memory, and verification.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a historical analogy and forecast, rather than a predetermined industrial outcome.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It gives readers a way to separate permanent needs from temporary product forms.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The next chapter applies that distinction to the unusually accessible AI startup.
